settings.label: Nozzle Temperature
settings.line: Nozzle Temperature: 240-270°C. Glass fiber improves thermal conductivity, so the material melts efficiently. Start at 240°C .

settings.label: Bed Temperature
settings.line: Bed Temperature: 40-60°C. For textured PEI plates, the lower end (45°C) often works well as the material releases easily when cool.

settings.label: Print Speed
settings.line: Print Speed: 30-100mm/s. The added stiffness allows for faster printing than unreinforced TPU.

settings.label: Layer Height
settings.line: Layer Height: 0.2mm is standard. Avoid very low layer heights (<0.1mm) as fibers can cause clogging in restricted flows.
